mapper.select: SELECT schedule_id, user_id, title, description, start_time, end_time, type, remind_time, repeat_rule FROM schedules WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY start_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedules (user_id, title, description, start_time, end_time, type, remind_time, repeat_rule) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{type}, #{remindTime}, #{repeatRule})
mapper.update: UPDATE schedules SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, type = #{type}, remind_time = #{remindTime}, repeat_rule = #{repeatRule} WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM schedules WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND user_id = #{userId}
